name: Seeking the Kor Gem
summary: In Ashenvale, Ulric Frostveil sees your search for a Kor Gem as familiar work for Alliance spellcasters. He points you north to Blackfathom Deeps, where naga still use the gems.

sections.title: A Gem in Ashenvale
sections.body: Ulric asks you to bring him a Kor Gem from the ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, north of Ashenvale. The naga below still use the gems. They can empower magical weapons and implements, but Ulric warns you not to go alone.

sections.title: Ulric's Interest
sections.body: Ulric Frostveil recognizes corruption in the gem. He says he can dispel the evil infused into it by the naga witches. Then he asks whether you would sell it to him for his academic pursuits.

faq.answer: Ulric Frostveil is a Forsaken in Ashenvale who asks you to bring him a Kor Gem.

faq.q: Where can I find a Kor Gem?
faq.answer: Ulric directs you north to Blackfathom Deeps, where naga still use Kor Gems.

faq.q: What are Kor Gems used for?
faq.answer: Kor Gems can empower magical weapons and implements.

faq.q: Why does Ulric want a Kor Gem?
faq.answer: Ulric asks you to bring him a Kor Gem. He says he may value it for his academic pursuits.
The naga in Blackfathom Deeps still use Kor Gems.
